ModMetaData.name: Advanced Mortar (Continued)
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Info.png[/img] Update of $$$s mod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1622501189
- Updated the price since the Vanilla turret is more expensive now - Works well with the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2339394453]Advanced Mini-Turret+[/url] mod by velcroboy333 - Seems enemies will now use the mortars as well, if they can afford them - Uses the reinforced barrel-mechanic if enabled, same as vanilla mortars.

[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img]
Adds upgraded version of the mortar. Details are attatched as images.
For players only. Enemies won't bring this to attack you.
Burst fire is not free. It consumes a shell per each shot. It's working just like a following video.
https://youtu.be/io3NHBKQSQ4
